title: 🔥当前周期复刻22年底部
body: 市场处于深度熊市筑底期。MVRV 为 1.19，仅略高于 2022-08 同期的 1.03，且低于历史 80% 的时间。估值水平与上一轮周期末段高度重合，显示筹码在低位充分沉淀，但缺乏增量驱动，短期难改磨底趋势。偏多。至暗时刻还剩多久？
body_en: The market is deep in a bear market bottoming phase. MVRV sits at 1.19, just slightly above the 1.03 from the same period in Aug '22, and lower than 80% of historical levels. Valuations are heavily overlapping with the tail end of the last cycle, showing chips are fully settling at the lows. But lacking incremental drivers, the grinding bottom trend is unlikely to break short-term. Leaning bullish. How much longer until the darkest hour passes?
